title: Android Button compound drawables
purpose: Check that supported Android XML Button drawables appear beside the text, follow RTL and respond to pressed state.
changes: The importer and renderer now support the existing solid shape and state-selector drawable subset on Button, including padding and wrap-content width.
steps: Under Button compound drawables, check Send: a blue circle and amber rounded rectangle should sit on opposite sides of the text without clipping. Tap it and confirm the button responds.
Press and hold Press me: its blue circle should disappear while pressed and return when released. The button should still respond.
Turn on Right-to-left layout. Send's blue and amber shapes should swap sides; press and hold Press me again. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The drawables reserve space beside the text, logical sides mirror in RTL, and the pressed selector changes while the button remains usable.
limits: This supports solid shapes and a subset of drawable selectors/tints. Bitmap, vector and animated drawables, complete Android tint compositing, vertical wrap measurement and device pixel/motion parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust checks cover width reservation, drawable positions, RTL, pressed selector and pressed tint.
159 Android XML importer tests passed including Button drawable and tint parsing.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified button interaction and RTL operation.
